content.short: TomTalk is a 'Talk-to-Earn' application on TON that rewards users for voice-based social engagement.
content.description: TomTalk is an innovative SocialFi application operating on the TON blockchain that introduces a unique 'Talk-to-Earn' model. It encourages users to engage in voice-based social activities, such as chatting, singing, and listening to music, rewarding them with digital tokens for their participation. TomTalk aims to monetize social engagement in a natural and interactive way, leveraging the social mechanics of the Telegram ecosystem. It provides a fun and rewarding platform for users to connect with others globally while earning value from their social contributions on TON.
content.meta: Join the Talk-to-Earn movement with TomTalk on TON. Earn rewards for voice engagement on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
